subject.title: Feature: Activity-aware run timeout (wall-clock timeout kills active multi-tool runs)

question: Should OpenClaw replace or augment the current wall-clock agent run timeout with an activity-aware idle deadline plus an absolute max-run cap?
rationale: The remaining fix changes core timeout semantics and likely config/default behavior, while the related open PRs only cover narrower symptoms and do not settle whether active progress should reset the gateway run deadline.

options.title: Idle plus max cap
options.body: Add an activity/idle deadline that resets on tool and model progress while retaining a separate absolute cap for runaway runs.

options.title: Notice-only mitigation
options.body: Keep the wall-clock deadline but prioritize the open timeout-notice work so users get a clear failure instead of silence.

options.title: No semantic change
options.body: Treat the current 48h default and per-run override workaround as sufficient and close the broader activity-aware request after documenting that policy.

recommendation.title: Idle plus max cap
recommendation.body: Add an activity/idle deadline that resets on tool and model progress while retaining a separate absolute cap for runaway runs.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties this account to the timeout resolver/default surface, and the decision is product/config semantics rather than a narrow mechanical repair.
